zh: 删掉一张卡片时，卡片按附件磁贴入场的反向退场：淡出并缩到 0.85，250ms，曲线与磁贴入场同一条；退场走完才换快照，其它卡片这时才开始收拢。
en: Removing a card now plays the attachment tile's entrance in reverse — fade out and shrink to 0.85 over 250 ms on the same curve — and the board swaps the snapshot only after the exit, so the other cards start closing in afterwards.
